fb_text:
The email every service business owner dreads: "Were you even here last week?"

You were. You know you were. But it's Thursday afternoon, the week's a blur, and now you're digging through old texts trying to reconstruct a visit while a client questions the invoice.

Here's what that conversation looks like with FieldNotes: your crew texts a quick note after every stop — what they did, what they saw. FieldNotes timestamps it, files it to the property, and can turn it into a client-ready recap you approve before it sends.

So when "were you even here?" lands in your inbox, the reply is one line: the log, with the time on it. Conversation over. Invoice paid.

I run a commercial plant service here in Atlanta covering 50+ corporate and commercial properties. The "prove you were here" email used to eat an hour of my evening. Now it takes thirty seconds.

See the recap flow in 60 seconds:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
